text:
Priya K: opened PR #501 to add an audit-export migration guide + compact examples. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 — tagging legal + eng for wording and API checks.
Jen H: quick skim looks promising. two asks: (1) add SOC2-friendly language about PII handling, (2) include a tiny retention table sample for docs.
Leo M: noted. i'll update examples — API surface changed: POST /v2/exports (not /v1/export) and the flag is pseudonymize: true/false. will add curl + node + ruby snippets.
Priya K: add a short migration note for SDKs: `audit.export` -> `audit_logs.export`, `mask_pii` renamed to `pseudonymize`, telemetry field `export_job_id` -> `job_id`. call that out under "migration notes".
Sara L (Legal): suggested wording: "By default, exported files do not contain tenant-identifying PII. Customers may request masked identifiers by setting `pseudonymize=true` on export. Export operations require auditor or admin role and are logged in the tenant audit trail." can we adopt that?
Jen H: that wording is good. i'll shorten slightly for inline docs: "Exports omit tenant PII by default. Use pseudonymize=true to include masked tenant identifiers. Exports require auditor/admin roles and are recorded in the audit trail."
Leo M: pushing snippets now. curl: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v2/exports" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant_id":"t_live_01","pseudonymize":true,"retention_days":90}'
``` node fetch: ```js
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.example/v2/exports',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${TOKEN}`},body:JSON.stringify({tenant_id:'t_live_01',pseudonymize:true,retention_days:90})});const data = await res.json();console.log(data.job_id);
``` ruby short: ```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
job = client.audit_logs.export(tenant_id: 't_live_01', pseudonymize: true, retention_days: 90)
puts job.job_id
```
Priya K: perfect — i'll add a 3-row retention sample (session_events:30, logs:365, exports_metadata:730) and a one-line note about tenant overrides.
docs-bot: PR 501 status: review requested by @Sara L (Legal), @Jen H. link-checker: internal anchors OK. docs-build: passed.
Sara L (Legal): leaving one tiny inline suggestion on punctuation, otherwise LGTM.
Priya K: thanks all, aiming to merge Monday after legal sign-off.
Leo M: added a migration bullet about telemetry name changes so external log parsers won't break.
Priya K: merging after legal confirm.
docs-bot: PR 501 merged by @Priya K — changelog updated.
